notes: Complete list: 4 actions (src/actions.ts, one of them, routeAudio, only when the device has audio-routable inputs and outputs) and 9 feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts). Ids are the camelCase values of the ActionId / FeedbackId enums; the source states they must never change.

Feedback types: 5 boolean (videoDestinationSinkConnected, videoSourceTally, videoSourceSyncDetected, audioSourceTally, automaticRouting) and 4 value (videoSource, videoDestinationName, videoSourceName, audioSource). There are no advanced feedbacks.

Protocol: HTTPS login (/userlogin.html, cookie session) and a secure WebSocket (wss://<host>/websockify) to a Crestron HD-MD matrix or HD-TXU extender; commands are JSON messages such as {"Device":{"AvMatrixRoutingV2":{"Routes":{"<Output>":{"VideoSource":"<Input>"}}}}}. Config fields: host, user, password (secret), "Disable certificate validation", verbose logs.

Source and destination ids are the device keys ("Input<n>", "Output<n>", "Aux<n>"; schemas/General.ts) and exist only at runtime, so every list is recorded with choicesNote, valueType string and valuePattern. The pattern is the device schema key regex, not a check the module applies to option values. Video-routing actions and the tally feedbacks list only entries with Capabilities.IsVideoRoutingSupported; the other lists show all entries.

The actions are only defined while crestronDevice data exists (UpdateActions returns early otherwise); unavailable actions are explicitly set to undefined. The routeVideo, routeAudio actions and the tally feedbacks have a learn() handler that reads the current route of the chosen destination into the source option; these handlers are not part of the catalog schema.

The "name" checkbox of videoSource / audioSource returns the user specified input name instead of the key; a destination configured with "No Source" returns the text "No Source" (name on) or 0 (name off).
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.2.2: options may be expressions (new child handler), none of the fields sets disableAutoExpression.
